name: CustomTool
description:
CustomTool is one tool the host app answers itself (SessionSpec.custom_tools):
 Claude Managed Agents' custom tool, its type implied.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The tool's name as the agent sees it: letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: What the tool does and when to call it, for the agent.

fields.name: InputSchema
fields.description: The JSON Schema the tool's input must match: an object schema.
